effect_description_eng:
[Security] At the end of the battle, give 2 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) Then, add this card to the hand.
[All Turns] While you have 1 or more memory, none of your opponent's Digimon can activate [When Digivolving] effects.
